## Constraints

### Must

- Off-white canvas, graphite typography, restrained violet accent
- Preserve Space Grotesk and IBM Plex Mono
- Selected Work immediately after Hero
- Featured / major / supporting project hierarchy
- Visible SSR baseline and reduced motion support

### Avoid

- Dark full-page gradients, glow, glassmorphism and looping simulations
- Invented metrics, dates, technologies and links
- Full Agentic Ops flagship or case-study implementation before Stage 04

## Decisions

- Stage 02: one coherent light system with semantic CSS colors and 48–88px section spacing.
- Reuse ActionLink, SectionLabel and hydration-safe Reveal; use compact Project Index row composition as inspiration for supporting work.
- Agentic Ops is a basic featured overview with an actual sample screenshot, KazEcoFood a major overview, and remaining work compact rows.


- Stage 03: server-rendered AI Product Developer Hero; asymmetric desktop composition, stacked tablet, real approval-inbox evidence with explicit sample status and mobile art direction.
- Hero uses existing Framer Motion for a short post-hydration transform entrance; no hidden SSR copy or looping backgrounds. Preview links to the existing Agentic Ops overview.
